meta.name: git-assistant
meta.description: Git版本控制助手。提供常用的Git命令封装、工作流指导和自动化操作。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言执行Git操作和管理版本库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用Git但记不住复杂命令
copy.tagline_en: Execute Git operations and manage repositories with natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git but struggle with complex commands

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你执行 Git 版本控制操作，如查看状态、提交、推送、拉取、分支管理、查看历史等，并指导解决冲突和提供工作流建议。
howto.when: 当你询问 Git 相关操作（如提交、分支、合并）或需要版本控制指导时触发。

say.text: 帮我查看当前 Git 仓库的状态。
say.note: Claude 会执行 git status 并返回结果。

say.text: 添加所有更改并提交，提交信息为“修复登录bug”。
创建一个新分支 feature/user-profile 并推送到远程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you perform Git version control operations such as checking status, committing, pushing, pulling, branch management, viewing history, and provide conflict resolution guidance and workflow suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Git operations (e.g., commit, branch, merge) or need version control guidance.

say_en.text: Show me the current Git repository status.
say_en.note: Claude will run git status and return the result.

say_en.text: Add all changes and commit with message 'Fix login bug'.
say_en.note: Claude will run git add . and git commit.

say_en.text: Create a new branch feature/user-profile and push to remote.
say_en.note: Claude will run git checkout -b and git push.
